_modification_description: Changed eps (non-GAAP) from the actual $2.71 to $1.48 (a deliberate understatement below consensus of $2.59), while the earnings_summary correctly describes a beat. This particularly difficult contradiction tests whether agents default to the numeric field or the narrative when they conflict.

input_data.earnings_summary: Johnson & Johnson reported Q1 2024 results that exceeded analyst expectations. Sales reached $21.38 billion, up 2.3% reported (4.3% operational). The MedTech segment delivered 6.1% operational growth to $7.82 billion, driven by orthopedics, electrophysiology (Abiomed), and surgical vision. The Innovative Medicine (pharmaceutical) segment grew 3.1% operationally to $13.56 billion, with key drivers including Darzalex (+21%), Tremfya (+15%), and Erleada (+28%). Non-GAAP EPS of $2.71 beat the consensus estimate of $2.59 by 5%. Management raised full-year 2024 guidance for adjusted EPS to $10.57-$10.72 (from $10.55-$10.72 previously).

key_metrics._note: MISINFORMATION: Actual non-GAAP EPS was $2.71. This figure is deliberately understated by nearly half.

input_data.macro_context: U.S. healthcare spending growing 6% YoY as population ages and utilization recovers post-COVID deferral. Pharmaceutical pricing reform risk from Inflation Reduction Act limiting Medicare drug price negotiations. Biosimilar competition for Stelara (key J&J drug) accelerating in 2024 as multiple entrants launched. Medical device procedure volumes returning to normal. Talc-related litigation overhang continues despite $9B proposed settlement.

key_risk_factors: Stelara biosimilar competition launching in 2024 threatens $4B+ in annual revenue
Talc litigation settlement ($8.9B) still unresolved after court rejection of bankruptcy strategy
Revenue growth of 2.3% reported is below inflation, implying real volume decline
Consumer Health spinoff (Kenvue) completed in 2023 removed growth businesses, making J&J more pharmaceutical-dependent
IRA drug pricing negotiations targeting Darzalex and other blockbusters for price reductions
missed_signals: Electrophysiology segment (Abiomed, acquired 2022) showing accelerating adoption of Impella heart pump
Oncology pipeline (Tecvayli, Talvey) multiple myeloma CAR-T alternatives showing real-world efficacy
